{"id":1603912344,"question_id":2998,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1744395584,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1603912344/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"  Count Symmetric Integers","memory":"9.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countSymmetricIntegers(int low, int high) {\n        int ans=0;\n\n        for(int i =low ; i<=high ; i++)\n        {\n            if(10 <= i && i <= 99 && (i % 11 == 0))\n            {\n                ans++;\n            }\n            \n            else if(1000 <= i && i <= 9999)\n            {\n                int first_digit = i / 1000;\n                int second_digit = (i / 100) % 10;\n                int third_digit = (i / 10) % 10;\n                int fourth_digit = i % 10;\n\n                if((first_digit + second_digit) == (third_digit + fourth_digit)) \n                {\n                    ans++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-symmetric-integers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":548}
